<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for the Peterson reaction. In the forward direction it forms a C=C bond while breaking an aliphatic hydroxyl (alcohol) and a trimethylsilyl group. We'll search the template catalog using these functional groups.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
